outcome.catalyst_materialized_note: The grid thesis materialized and the position still lost 22%. US utility capex was revised to $1.3-1.4tn for 2026-30, +27% on the prior $1.1tn plan (S&P Global / PowerLines, 2026-04-14), and struct_energy_transition_grid intensity ROSE 85.6 -> 87.2 over the holding period. Three of four checkable assumptions validated. The loss was the VEHICLE, not the thesis: over 2026-06-05 -> 2026-08-31 IQQH.DE -19.7% tracked the solar basket (TAN -24.0%, ICLN -17.8%) rather than the grid basket (GRID -4.1%, XLU -3.0%); EURUSD moved -0.08% and pnl_fx_eur was EUR 0.00, so duration explains ~3pp of the 22.9pp and instrument selection ~15.6pp. IQQH.DE's registered name is 'iShares Global Clean Energy Transition UCITS ETF' and market_data.py:63 already documented that no grid-pure UCITS vehicle exists in the universe. The actual driver of the drawdown - the OBBBA 45Y/48E phase-out for construction starting after 2026-07-04, plus 25D expiry - has NO registered catalyst, which is why catalyst_alignment read 92.3 while the line bled. Right thesis, wrong instrument, unmodelled headwind.
